subject: Television & Streaming
title: Vince Gilligan's Moral Laboratory
description: Learn Vince Gilligan's Moral Laboratory in one minute.

hook.text: Vince Gilligan pitched Breaking Bad as 'Mr. Chips becomes Scarface.' Nobody understood it. AMC took the risk.

buildup.text: Walter White started as a sympathetic teacher and slowly transformed into a monster. Gilligan mapped every moral step.

discovery.text: Gilligan planned the ending before writing the middle.

twist.text: Audiences kept rooting for Walter long after he became evil. Gilligan was disturbed by how much viewers forgave.

climax.text: Breaking Bad is widely considered the greatest TV drama ever made—a show where every scene served the whole.

punchline.text: He turned a chemistry teacher into television's greatest villain.

quiz.question: How did Vince Gilligan describe the arc of Breaking Bad?
